**PotentialBreaks 1.1.2**: a new, more polished look.

- Barlow fonts, raised panels with soft shadows, glowing amber knob arcs, even-sized button labels and darker display wells. The same controls in the same places.
- MIDI from other tracks (for example a controller set to Global) can no longer change the plugin's settings. Q-Links still work.

Saved projects keep working. **Download** `PotentialBreaks-1.1.2-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
